about: Krish's standing yes to every checked video script going into his teleprompter.com account, and exactly what a session may do there. Read by scripts/post-pack/teleprompter_send.py and making.py teleprompter; nothing is sent or recorded unless status is "confirmed". The calls are made by a Claude Code session that holds the Teleprompter connector (make-piece, the Scripts step); this repository holds no Teleprompter key.

switch.words: Also note that Descript is permanently gone, teleprompter.com is permanently in, connected via MCP here

send.asked: May every checked script go into your teleprompter.com account automatically, starting with Monday's two now?
send.terms: One script per cut, in a folder per piece (e.g. "Mon 12 Oct follow.the.money"). When the words change, the same script is updated in place. Nothing is ever deleted.

never: deleting anything: Teleprompter has no delete tool, and nothing is ever deleted
move_script and update_folder: a script stays where it was made, and a folder keeps its name
a second folder for a piece, or a second script for a cut: a cut whose script is recorded is updated in place
fontSize, speed, alignment or timedSpeed, on a create or an update: Krish may set them, and they stay his

duration: the script's spoken words / 150 minutes, in whole seconds
text: the script file's spoken words, any markdown stripped, its paragraphs separated by a blank line
